description: Opaque rust-red floor-length gown with a low square neckline, fitted bodice and elbow-length sleeves. Fine gold-brown floral woven trim runs around the neckline, shoulder straps, cuffs, front opening and bottom hem. A decorated leather or woven waist belt carries several round metal plaques and a central clasp. A cream underdress with restrained brown embroidery is visible through the front skirt. An ochre-gold shoulder wrap with burgundy ornamental borders rests loosely around the forearms and hangs down both sides. Small earrings, a pendant necklace and brown closed leather shoes are visible. No headgear, armor or weapon is present.
